summary: Empties the columns a predicate selects, leaving the columns in place.
description: `clearRowsByConditional` turned on its side: the contents go, the columns stay, so the letters of the columns after them do not change.
The sheet is read once and the clearing is grouped into consecutive blocks.

params.predicate: Receives the column's cells, its one-based position and — when `headerColumn` is set — the column keyed by the row names. Return `true` for the columns to act on.
params.options: `headerColumn` names the column holding the row names, and keeps that column out of the candidates.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is not a sheet.
throws.IllegalArgumentException: the predicate is not a function, or the header position is not a positive integer.
